# GitLab Runner Framework

Apply the following gitlab runner framework guidance to the code or configuration you are changing. Check the stated preconditions and preserve behavior outside the authorized scope.

- Skill: `gitlab-runner`
- Source of truth: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/gitlab/skills/gitlab-runner/SKILL.md`
- Runtime agent config: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/gitlab/skills/gitlab-runner/agents/openai.yaml`
